title: Barnsley Fern
subtitle: Iterated Function System Botanical Attractor
description: Michael Barnsley's classic affine IFS fractal simulating the self-similar frond morphology of the Asplenium adiantum-nigrum black spleenwort fern.
mathNotation: f_i(\mathbf{x}) = \begin{bmatrix} a_i & b_i \\ c_i & d_i \end{bmatrix} \mathbf{x} + \begin{bmatrix} e_i \\ f_i \end{bmatrix}, \quad P(f_1)=0.01, P(f_2)=0.85, P(f_3)=0.07, P(f_4)=0.07
